reviews.comment: He is okay. He knows a lot about what he is teaching but it can be very boring to listen to with his monotone voice. His tests are 1/3 multiple choice, 1/3 short answer and 1/3 essay because he says people don't like multiple choice tests. Have few easy participation assignments and then a term paper. Take if you want to be bored
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Professor. I messed up bad on a test and got a B because of it, but it was entirely my fault. Dr. Petersen does a great job explaining the concepts, and is a fair grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: took him during COVID and loved him. Wish I couldve taken him in person. His class is very manageable and I loved the discussions. He is a really great professor and really does his best to ensure success. Two exams and research paper comprise your grade along with participation in groups. Will be taking him again if possible!
